svg.title: Rotator cuff: anterior and posterior views
svg.desc: Right shoulder, deltoid removed. Left panel anterior: subscapularis fills the front of the scapula and inserts on the lesser tubercle. Right panel posterior: supraspinatus above the scapular spine, infraspinatus below it, teres minor along the lateral inferior border. Each cuff muscle runs into a tendon that attaches to the humerus: supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor to the greater tubercle, subscapularis to the lesser tubercle. Teres major (greyer tone) runs from the inferior scapular angle to the proximal medial humeral shaft and is NOT a rotator cuff muscle.
